# sherpa-node-row

One row of a [sherpa-node](sherpa-node.md): an input socket, a field and an output socket. Any of the three may be absent. Will, TODO 78.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-node-row/sherpa-node-row.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-node-row/sherpa-node-row.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-node-row/sherpa-node-row.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-node-row/sherpa-node-row.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-node-row/sherpa-node-row.example.json) |

## When to use it

For one row of a `sherpa-node`: an input socket, a field and an output socket, each one optional. The field is a `sherpa-input-text` — text, a select or a number — and names itself; a row with no field names itself with `data-label`. For the whole node's sockets, set them on the node.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-node data-heading="Filter" data-icon="filter" data-input-socket="object"><sherpa-node-row><sherpa-input-text data-label="Key" name="key" data-type="select"></sherpa-input-text></sherpa-node-row><sherpa-node-row data-input-socket="value"><sherpa-input-text data-label="Value" name="value" value="active"></sherpa-input-text></sherpa-node-row><sherpa-node-row data-label="Matches" data-output-socket="value"></sherpa-node-row></sherpa-node>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-input-socket` | `value` `object` |  | an input socket on the start edge: value (a circle) \| object (a diamond) |
| `data-label` | text |  | the row's name, when it has no field: a field names itself |
| `data-output-socket` | `value` `object` |  | an output socket on the end edge: value (a circle) \| object (a diamond) |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `socketRect(side: SocketSide)` | A socket's box on the screen, for a connector to join; null when the row has none. |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| (default) | input | the field: a [sherpa-input-text](sherpa-input-text.md) — a text field, a select or a number |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`label`, `row`, `socket-in`, `socket-out`

`{ inputSocket?, label?, outputSocket? }`

Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.
